- src/maintenance/detect.ts (REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE) - detectStaleAnnotations(codebasePath: string): string[] - Resolves workspace root from process.cwd() and codebasePath. - If root does not exist or is not a directory, returns [] (safe no-op). - Uses getAllFiles(workspaceRoot) to traverse all files under root. - Reads each file and scans for `@story ` via regex. - Uses storyReferenceUtils.isUnsafeStoryPath to skip unsafe paths (absolute, traversal, invalid extension) before any fs checks. - Resolves project- and codebase-relative candidates, enforces boundaries with enforceProjectBoundary, and only checks in-project candidates. - Uses existsSync on in-project candidates; if none exist, adds the original storyPath to a Set of stale annotations. - Returns a de-duplicated array of stale story paths.
- Tests validating REQ-MAINT-DETECT and error handling: - tests/maintenance/detect.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] should return empty array when no stale annotations" (no files with @story => []). - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] should detect stale annotation references" (creates file with @story stale.story.md and asserts result contains that path). - tests/maintenance/detect-isolated.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] returns empty array when directory does not exist" (non-existent root => []). - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detects stale annotations in nested directories" (nested files with annotations => detects both stale.story.md entries). - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] throws error on permission denied" (chmod 000 on subdir, expect detectStaleAnnotations to throw so CLI wrapper can catch appropriately). - "[REQ-MAINT-DETECT] performs security validation for unsafe and invalid-extension story paths without stat'ing outside workspace" (verifies that existsSync is never called on malicious relative/absolute/invalid-extension paths, only on normalized in-workspace candidates).
- src/maintenance/update.ts (REQ-MAINT-UPDATE) - updateAnnotationReferences(codebasePath, oldPath, newPath): number - If codebasePath does not exist or is not a directory, returns 0 (safe no-op). - Escapes oldPath for regex and builds `new RegExp('(@story\\s*)' + escapedOldPath, 'g')`. - Traverses all files under codebasePath using getAllFiles. - For each regular file: - Reads content as UTF-8. - Replaces matches using a callback `(match, p1) => p1 + newPath`, preserving the original `@story` prefix and whitespace (formatting) and only changing the path. - Writes the file back only when content changed. - Returns the count of updated @story annotations.
- Tests: - tests/maintenance/update-isolated.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] updates @story annotations in files" (creates file with @story old.path.md; after call, content contains @story new.path.md and count is 1). - "[REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] should return 0 when directory does not exist" (non-existent root => 0). - tests/maintenance/update.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] should return 0 when no updates made" (directory with no matching annotations => 0).
- src/maintenance/batch.ts (REQ-MAINT-BATCH, REQ-MAINT-VERIFY) - batchUpdateAnnotations(codebasePath, mappings) - Loops over `{ oldPath, newPath }` mappings, calling updateAnnotationReferences for each and summing counts. - verifyAnnotations(codebasePath) - Calls detectStaleAnnotations(codebasePath) and returns `stale.length === 0`. - Tests: - tests/maintenance/batch.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-BATCH] should return 0 when no mappings applied" (empty array => 0). - "[REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] should return true when annotations are valid" (ensures `verifyAnnotations` returns true when codebase has matching @story comments and story files).
- src/maintenance/report.ts (REQ-MAINT-REPORT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE) - generateMaintenanceReport(codebasePath: string): string - Calls detectStaleAnnotations(root). - When no stale annotations: returns "" (empty string) indicating nothing to report. - When stale annotations exist: joins them with newlines into a simple report. - Tests: - tests/maintenance/report.test.ts - "[REQ-MAINT-REPORT] should return empty string when no operations". - "[REQ-MAINT-REPORT] should report stale story annotation" (writes a file with @story non-existent.story.md; report includes that path).
- src/maintenance/utils.ts - getAllFiles(dir: string): string[] - Validates dir exists and is a directory; otherwise returns []. - Recursively traverses the tree collecting regular file paths. - Shared helper for detect/update to keep traversal consistent and simple. ,CLI implementation and user feedback / error handling (REQ-MAINT-*, acceptance criteria on UX and errors): - src/maintenance/flags.ts - Minimal, predictable CLI flag parsing with defaults and validation. - Supports: --root, --json, --format text|json, --from, --to, --dry-run. - Throws on invalid --format value, which is surfaced to the CLI entry and covered by tests.
- src/maintenance/commands.ts - EXIT codes defined: EXIT_OK = 0, EXIT_STALE = 1, EXIT_USAGE = 2.
- handleDetect(normalized): number - Parses flags, runs detectStaleAnnotations(root). - If --json: prints JSON `{ root, stale }`. - If no stale annotations: prints `No stale @story annotations found.`. - If stale annotations: prints each path and a summary line with guidance. - Returns EXIT_OK when clean, EXIT_STALE when stale (REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE).
- handleVerify(normalized): number - Uses verifyAnnotations(root). - On success: prints `All traceability annotations under are valid.` and EXIT_OK. - On failure: prints message pointing to detect/report and EXIT_STALE (REQ-MAINT-VERIFY, REQ-MAINT-SAFE).
- handleReport(normalized): number - Uses generateMaintenanceReport(root). - When `format === 'json'`: prints `{ root, report }` JSON. - When no report: prints `No stale @story annotations found. Nothing to report.`. - When report exists: prints markdown-styled report with header and list of stale references. - Always returns EXIT_OK (REQ-MAINT-REPORT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE).
- handleUpdate(normalized): number - Validates that flags.from and flags.to are provided; otherwise prints error and returns EXIT_USAGE (REQ-MAINT-SAFE). - If `--dry-run`: - Does NOT modify files. - Uses generateMaintenanceReport(root) to estimate impact, computes estimatedStaleCount. - Prints human summary or JSON `{ mode: 'dry-run', root, from, to, estimatedStaleCount }`. - EXIT_OK. - Else (real update): - Calls updateAnnotationReferences(root, from, to) and prints textual or JSON summary of how many annotations were updated. - EXIT_OK.

- src/maintenance/cli.ts - runMaintenanceCli(rawArgv: string[]): number - Uses normalizeCliArgs. - If no subcommand or help flag: prints full help text and returns EXIT_OK (REQ-MAINT-SAFE, good UX). - Routes known subcommands to their handlers (detect, verify, report, update). - For update handler: if it returns EXIT_USAGE, re-prints help. - For unknown commands: prints `Unknown command: `, help, EXIT_USAGE. - Wraps handling in try/catch; on unexpected error logs `traceability-maint failed: ` and EXIT_USAGE (REQ-MAINT-SAFE error handling).
